log_level.description: Logging level (DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL)

bind_address.description: IP address on which the mdns service listens for DNS queries (e.g., 0.0.0.0, 127.0.0.1)

max_response_size.description: Maximum DNS response size in bytes (for EDNS0)

workers.description: Number of worker processes (parallel threads) to handle DNS queries

doh_bind_address.description: Bind address for DoH (used only if doh_enabled=true)

doh_port.description: Port for DoH (used only if doh_enabled=true)

tls_cert_file.description: Path to TLS certificate for DoH (required if doh_enabled=true)

tls_key_file.description: Path to TLS private key for DoH (required if doh_enabled=true)

doh_max_conns.description: Maximum number of concurrent DoH connections

upstream_dns_servers.description: List of upstream DNS servers for recursive resolution (IPv4 or IPv6 addresses with optional port, e.g., '8.8.8.8', '1.1.1.1#53')

enable_dnssec_validation.description: Enable DNSSEC validation of responses from upstream servers

trust_anchor_file.description: Path to trust anchor file (e.g., IANA root KSK) for DNSSEC validation

axfr_rate_limit.description: Maximum AXFR queries per source IP per minute (set 0 for unlimited)

allowed_axfr_range.description: Comma-separated list of CIDR ranges allowed to perform AXFR (empty = allow all)

enable_pool_monitoring.description: Enable health monitoring of pool targets (e.g., BIND, PowerDNS)

pool_id.description: ID of the pool to monitor (relevant in multi-pool setups)

rpc_topic.description: RPC topic (queue/exchange) used to communicate with other designate services

rpc_port.description: Port for internal RPC communication (if applicable)

neg_ttl.description: TTL for negative responses (NXDOMAIN, NODATA) in seconds

soa_ttl.description: TTL for SOA records served by this mdns

soa_minimum.description: Minimum TTL for SOA records (used for NXDOMAIN caching)

soa_retry.description: Retry interval for secondary DNS refresh

soa_expire.description: Expire time for zone data on secondaries

soa_primary_ns.description: Primary nameserver (NS) to include in SOA records

soa_email.description: Admin email (in DNS format) for SOA records

soa_additional_ns.description: Additional NS records to include in the SOA authority section

api_endpoint.description: Designate central API endpoint (used by mdns to fetch zone data)

auth_type.description: Authentication method for API connection ('none' or 'keystone')

api_tls_verify.description: Verify TLS certificate for API connections (if enabled)

api_tls_ca_file.description: CA bundle for API TLS verification (if api_tls_verify=true)
